annotation.title_clean: Strategie der Bundesregierung für Künstliche Intelligenz – Annex: Artificial Intelligence Mission Austria 2030 (AIM AT 2030)
annotation.title_en: Federal Government Strategy for Artificial Intelligence – Annex: Artificial Intelligence Mission Austria 2030 (AIM AT 2030)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Bundesministerium für Klimaschutz, Umwelt, Energie, Mobilität, Innovation und Technologie (BMK)
annotation.venue: Digital Skills and Jobs Platform (BMK, Vienna)
annotation.summary_en: Annex to Austria's 2021 national AI strategy (AIM AT 2030) outlining sectoral AI application fields: climate, energy, mobility, manufacturing, agriculture, space, smart cities, construction, health, culture and education. It commits the federal government to funding, research programmes, test environments and EU cooperation, emphasising climate protection and human-centred, rights-respecting AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Government will draft a master plan for AI applications against climate change for the next strategy version.
AI-specific priorities in energy research programmes, innovation labs and model regions.
Funding for AI projects in agriculture with mandatory collaboration between competence centres.
Examine participation in EU AI testing and experimentation facilities (TEFs) under Digital Europe.
All applications must be human-centred and respect fundamental rights.
